name: Selects Setup
description: Builds the day Selects sequences from the footage bins. Scan footage reads the footage bin (select it in the Project panel, e.g. 02 FOOTAGE/LakePlacid, or type its path): its Day bins and the camera/source bins in each day. Set the block order, the label (marker name) and colour of each block, and which day a clip in two days belongs to. Build makes, per day, "<Project> Day NN_Selects UNCUT" (every clip of the day, one block per source back to back, a gap between blocks, a marker over each block; recorder wavs on their own audio track) and an empty "<Project> Day NN_Selects", files them in 01 SEQUENCES/Selects and Selects/UNCUT, and checks every clip. Existing sequences are left alone; clips are never renamed; nothing is saved. Don't click in Premiere while it builds.

inputs.label: Name in the sequence names (optional)
inputs.placeholder: e.g. Lake Placid; empty = the project file's name

actions.label: Build Selects sequences
actions.confirm: Build the day Selects sequences with the blocks and choices shown? For each day a new "Selects UNCUT" sequence with every clip of that day and an empty "Selects" sequence are made and filed in 01 SEQUENCES/Selects. Existing sequences and clips are not changed and nothing is saved. Please don't click in Premiere until it says it has finished.
